item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 08/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine and very hot over southern China in the next couple of days. Besides, the area of low pressure now over the northeastern part of the South China Sea will remain relatively weak today and tomorrow. There will be showers over the region in the next few days. With the anticyclone aloft shifting northwards, showers will increase gradually over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Tropical Cyclone Podul is expected to move westwards in the next few days and develop gradually, move towards in the general direction of the vicinity of Taiwan. However, there are still uncertainties in its subsequent movement and intensity. It will have a higher chance of moving towards the vicinity of the coast of Fujian and Guangdong.
